title: Fix 2.5D shadow lifecycle and alignment
description: World25D can crash when proxy references are freed, and current shadow origin/profile makes actors look like they float. Fix weak-ref/node validity checks and align cast/contact shadows to sprite feet.
close_reason: Fixed World25D stale proxy casts and retuned shadow anchors; Godot MCP smoke showed no crash log

title: Design 2.5D render migration
description: Why: replace fragile 2D shadow fakery with a 2.5D render layer that keeps 2D gameplay but uses 3D orthographic camera, Sprite3D/card sprites, real DirectionalLight3D shadows, and per-asset shadow proxies. What: inspect current Level/characters/background, propose safe migration architecture, then implement after user approves design.
close_reason: Implemented 2.5D-style lighting/shadow pass and verified Godot smoke

title: Fix shadow crash and projection axis
description: Why: visual_effects.gd crashes when stored AnimatedSprite2D shadow references point at freed nodes, and current silhouette projection maps image axes incorrectly so shadows look off-axis and too stretched. What: store weak refs for animated shadows, remove dead entries safely, rotate projection so local Y maps to cast direction, reduce cast stretch, and verify with MCP logs/screenshot.
close_reason: Fixed freed-object crash using WeakRef tracked animated shadows, corrected projection axis with -PI/2 rotation, reduced shadow stretch, and verified 35-second MCP run with clean logs.

title: Correct silhouette shadow orientation
description: Why: silhouette shadows now match object shapes, but they use the sprite horizontal axis as cast direction, making shadows appear rotated 90 degrees and overstretched. What: rotate projection so sprite vertical axis casts away from sun, reduce stretch, and verify with Godot MCP screenshot/logs.
close_reason: Corrected silhouette shadow projection so sprite vertical axis casts down-left, reducing 90-degree orientation error and overstretch; verified with Godot MCP screenshot/logs.

title: Make shadows match object silhouettes
description: Why: current lighting pass uses generic thin oval/cast shadows, so grasses, bushes, rocks, and actors read as same line instead of matching their art. What: replace generic shadow geometry with per-object silhouette-based cast shadows scaled by texture/body size and verify with Godot MCP screenshot.
close_reason: Replaced generic oval cast shadows with per-object silhouette shadows for actors, rocks, bushes, and grass; verified with Godot MCP screenshot and clean logs.

title: Fix visible cast shadows for actors and scenery
description: Why: user reports player/enemy shadows are missing and vegetation shadows are clipped/weird, with rocks missing shadows. What: diagnose shadow rendering root cause, restore preferred long painted shadow concept with coherent sun direction, ensure actors and scenery visibly cast shadows, then verify through Godot MCP screenshot/logs.
close_reason: Fixed actor shadow render order and replaced sprite-copy environment shadows with procedural down-left cast shadows; verified with Godot MCP run and screenshot.

title: Implement overhead biased sun shadows
description: Match Spell Brigade-style lighting with high overhead sun, slight east bias, compact contact shadows, and less filter-like 2D lighting.
close_reason: Implemented overhead/east-biased sun model with compact contact shadows and verified via Godot MCP screenshot/logs.

title: Improve lighting depth and tile blending
description: Hide visible background tile seams, strengthen directional shadows, and make lighting read as one infinite-world sun instead of a flat filter.
close_reason: Removed per-tile ground shader/tint variation, blended background tiles to one base texture, and switched to painted directional shadows from one upper-left sun. Verified with MCP screenshot and clean logs.

title: Tune golden hour lighting consistency
description: Reduce visual brightness and align shadow/rim/background effects to a single golden-hour light source.
close_reason: Reduced exposure, removed extra local/fill lights, and aligned shadows/haze/rim to one upper-left sun direction. Verified with Godot MCP capture and clean logs.

title: Golden hour visual overhaul
description: Implement golden-hour 2D lighting, shader, shadow, and background effects while preserving hand-drawn sprite readability.
notes: Implemented focused visual overhaul files and Level wiring. Runtime visual verification remains blocked: Godot MCP is not listening at http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp and no godot/godot4/godot4.6 CLI is on PATH in this shell.
close_reason: Implemented golden-hour visual overhaul and verified through Godot MCP bridge with clean game/editor logs and captured gameplay screenshot.

title: Document game agent guardrails and beads workflow
description: Add game-development Brooks-Lint guardrails to AGENTS.md, initialize beads for the repo, and document bead workflow expectations for future agents.
close_reason: Added game-development guardrails and beads workflow to AGENTS.md; initialized beads for the repo.
